cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the 2-line discount of the family bundle discount for the teen & kids line?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 2,000. It is the value in GUIDE-FAMILY-TEEN Article 2 and was not amended in 2026.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the HIGH-tier limit of the port-in switch bonus for the 5G smartphone line?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 300,000. It is the value in GUIDE-SWITCH-5G Article 3(1) and was not amended in 2026.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the damage deductible of the device insurance for the LTE smartphone line?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 40,000. It is the value in GUIDE-INSUR-LTE Article 3(2) and was not amended in 2026.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the loss coverage rate of the device insurance for the tablet & wearable line?
cqs.expected_answer: 70%. It is the value in GUIDE-INSUR-TAB Article 2(1) and was not amended in 2026.

cqs.question: Until how many days after activation can device insurance be taken out on the tablet & wearable line?
cqs.expected_answer: Within 14 days of activation (GUIDE-INSUR-TAB Article 1).

cqs.question: Until how many days after activation can device insurance be taken out on the 5G smartphone line?
cqs.expected_answer: Within 30 days of activation (GUIDE-INSUR-5G Article 1).

What damage deductible of the device insurance applied to a tablet & wearable line incident dated 2026-05-13?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 25,000. History up to 2026-05-13: KRW 30,000 (GUIDE-INSUR-TAB, 2026-01-01) → KRW 25,000 (NOTICE-2026-05, 2026-05-01). Later amendments do not apply to this case.

cqs.question: What minimum time with the previous carrier of the port-in switch bonus applied to a 5G smartphone line activation dated 2026-04-13?
cqs.expected_answer: 120 days. History up to 2026-04-13: 90 days (GUIDE-SWITCH-5G, 2026-01-01) → 120 days (NOTICE-2026-04, 2026-04-01). Later amendments do not apply to this case.

cqs.question: What MID-tier limit of the port-in switch bonus applied to a LTE smartphone line activation dated 2026-02-13?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 170,000. History up to 2026-02-13: KRW 150,000 (GUIDE-SWITCH-LTE, 2026-01-01) → KRW 170,000 (NOTICE-2026-02, 2026-02-01). Later amendments do not apply to this case.

cqs.question: What HIGH-tier limit of the port-in switch bonus applied to a tablet & wearable line activation dated 2026-04-13?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 110,000. History up to 2026-04-13: KRW 100,000 (GUIDE-SWITCH-TAB, 2026-01-01) → KRW 110,000 (NOTICE-2026-04, 2026-04-01). Later amendments do not apply to this case.

cqs.question: What 4-or-more-line discount of the family bundle discount applied to a teen & kids line bill dated 2026-02-13?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 5,500. History up to 2026-02-13: KRW 5,000 (GUIDE-FAMILY-TEEN, 2026-01-01) → KRW 5,500 (NOTICE-2026-02, 2026-02-01). Later amendments do not apply to this case.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the maximum switch bonus for a port-in at a designated island or mountain store on an LTE smartphone line MID-tier plan?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 216,000. The current MID-tier limit KRW 180,000 × 120% under ADDENDUM-EX-01 Addendum Article 1.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what is the maximum switch bonus for a port-in at a designated island or mountain store on a tablet & wearable line HIGH-tier plan?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 85,000. The 120% island uplift does not apply to the tablet & wearable line (ADDENDUM-EX-02 Addendum Article 2), so the current HIGH-tier limit applies as it is.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, a 17-year-old with a guardian's consent form ports in to a 5G smartphone line HIGH-tier plan. What is the maximum switch bonus?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 150,000. The current HIGH-tier limit KRW 300,000 × 50% for a minor's line (ADDENDUM-EX-01 Addendum Article 3).

cqs.question: As of October 2026, a 15-year-old with a guardian's consent form ports in to a teen & kids line HIGH-tier plan. What is the maximum switch bonus?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 180,000. The 50% restriction for minors does not apply to the teen & kids line (ADDENDUM-EX-02 Addendum Article 1), so 100% of the current HIGH-tier limit is available.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, what loss deductible rate applies when a 70-year-old customer loses an LTE smartphone line device?
cqs.expected_answer: 25%. The current LTE smartphone line loss deductible rate 30% minus 5 percentage points for customers aged 65 or over (ADDENDUM-EX-02 Addendum Article 4).

cqs.question: A customer ported in on 2026-07-20 to a 5G smartphone line HIGH-tier plan and received the switch bonus up to that day's limit. What is clawed back if they cancel on day 120? (no promotion, no exception)
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 100,000. That day's HIGH-tier limit was KRW 300,000; Activated on or after 2026-07-01 and 90–179 days elapsed, so pro-rata: 300,000 × (180 − 120) ÷ 180.

cqs.question: A customer ported in on 2026-05-18 to a 5G smartphone line HIGH-tier plan and received the switch bonus up to that day's limit. What is clawed back if they cancel on day 120? (no promotion, no exception)
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 300,000. That day's HIGH-tier limit was KRW 300,000; The pro-rata rule does not apply to this 5G smartphone line activation date, so cancelling within 180 days means clawback in full.

cqs.question: A customer ported in on 2026-08-05 to a teen & kids line HIGH-tier plan and received the switch bonus up to that day's limit. What is clawed back if they cancel on day 100? (no promotion, no exception)
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 180,000. That day's HIGH-tier limit was KRW 180,000; The pro-rata rule does not apply to this teen & kids line activation date, so cancelling within 180 days means clawback in full.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, a LTE smartphone line on a KRW 69,000 plan is in a 3-line family bundle, has the selective discount and is in its 6th year. What is the monthly payment?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 44,750. 69,000 × 0.75 = 51,750, minus the 3-line bundle discount 4,000 and the 5-year loyalty discount 3,000.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, a teen & kids line on a KRW 49,000 plan is in a 4-line family bundle, has the selective discount and is in its 6th year. What is the monthly payment?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 29,750. 49,000 × 0.75 = 36,750, minus the 4-or-more-line bundle discount 5,000 and the 5-year loyalty discount 2,000.

cqs.question: An insured customer lost a tablet & wearable line device with a list price of KRW 1,200,000 on 10 October 2026. How much is actually paid?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 714,000. Coverage on the incident date 70% = 840,000; deductible 15% = 126,000.

cqs.question: A 5G smartphone line device with a list price of KRW 1,000,000 at activation is returned on 12 October 2026 after 24 months, graded B. What is the reward?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 160,000. The 24-month rate on the return date 20% = 200,000, × 80% for grade B.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, which of the four product lines has the highest MID-tier limit for the port-in switch bonus, and what is the value?
cqs.expected_answer: The 5G smartphone line, at KRW 200,000. Current values: 5G smartphone KRW 200,000, LTE smartphone KRW 180,000, tablet & wearable KRW 60,000, teen & kids KRW 120,000.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, which of the four product lines has the lowest 3-line discount for the family bundle discount, and what is the value?
cqs.expected_answer: The tablet & wearable line, at KRW 1,500. Current values: 5G smartphone KRW 6,000, LTE smartphone KRW 4,000, tablet & wearable KRW 1,500, teen & kids KRW 4,500.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, which of the four product lines has the highest loss deductible rate for the device insurance, and what is the value?
cqs.expected_answer: The 5G smartphone, LTE smartphone line, at 30%. Current values: 5G smartphone 30%, LTE smartphone 30%, tablet & wearable 15%, teen & kids 20%.

cqs.question: As of October 2026, which of the four product lines has the highest reward rate after 12 months for the device trade-in reward, and what is the value?
cqs.expected_answer: The 5G smartphone line, at 65%. Current values: 5G smartphone 65%, LTE smartphone 50%, tablet & wearable 40%, teen & kids 45%.

cqs.question: List every 2026 change to the reward rate after 12 months of the device trade-in reward for the 5G smartphone line, in order of effective date.
List every 2026 change to the 2-line discount of the family bundle discount for the tablet & wearable line, in order of effective date.

Right now, what's the loss cover rate of the PhoneCare for the LTE phone?
cqs.expected_answer: 75%. 'LTE phone' is the LTE smartphone line, 'PhoneCare' the device insurance, 'loss cover rate' the loss coverage rate. History: 75% (GUIDE-INSUR-LTE, 2026-01-01) → 70% (NOTICE-2026-03, 2026-03-01) → 75% (NOTICE-2026-07, 2026-07-01).

cqs.question: Right now, what's the damage cap of the PhoneCare for the second device?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 210,000. 'second device' is the tablet & wearable line, 'PhoneCare' the device insurance, 'damage cap' the damage coverage cap. History: KRW 200,000 (GUIDE-INSUR-TAB, 2026-01-01) → KRW 220,000 (NOTICE-2026-03, 2026-03-01) → KRW 210,000 (NOTICE-2026-09, 2026-09-01).

cqs.question: Right now, what's the 3-line pack discount of the Fam pack for the Teens line?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 4,500. 'Teens line' is the teen & kids line, 'Fam pack' the family bundle discount, '3-line pack discount' the 3-line discount. History: KRW 3,500 (GUIDE-FAMILY-TEEN, 2026-01-01) → KRW 4,500 (NOTICE-2026-03, 2026-03-01).

cqs.question: Right now, what's the 3-year long-run discount of the Long-run discount for the LTE phone?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 2,000. 'LTE phone' is the LTE smartphone line, 'Long-run discount' the loyalty discount, '3-year long-run discount' the discount from 3 years. History: KRW 1,500 (GUIDE-LOYAL-LTE, 2026-01-01) → KRW 2,000 (NOTICE-2026-02, 2026-02-01).

cqs.question: Assuming customer CUST_DEMO_002 has device insurance, how much is actually paid if they lose their current device on 10 October 2026?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 951,104. CUST_DEMO_002's device is the Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB (list price 1,698,400, 5G smartphone line); coverage on the incident date 80% = 1,358,720, deductible 30% = 407,616.

cqs.question: If customer CUST_DEMO_004's line joins a 3-line family bundle, what is the monthly payment of that line as of october 2026?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 57,750. CUST_DEMO_004 is on 5G Premier Essential (KRW 85,000) with the selective discount: 85,000 × 0.75 = 63,750, minus the 5G smartphone line 3-line bundle discount 6,000.

cqs.question: Assuming customer CUST_DEMO_005 joined the trade-in reward and has met the 12-month requirement, what is the reward for a grade-A return on 12 October 2026?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 1,300,000. CUST_DEMO_005's device is the iPhone 16 Pro 512GB (list price 2,000,000) and the 5G smartphone line 12-month rate on the return date is 65%.

cqs.question: Assuming customer CUST_DEMO_007 ported in on their activation date, what switch bonus limit applied for that date and plan?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 200,000. CUST_DEMO_007 activated on 2026-09-01 on 5G Direct 61 (KRW 61,000, MID tier); the 5G smartphone line MID-tier limit that day was KRW 200,000.

cqs.question: What is the list price of the Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB?
cqs.expected_answer: KRW 1,698,400 (devices table).

cqs.question: How many customers are senior/welfare exempt (SENIOR_EXEMPT), and who are they?
cqs.expected_answer: Two: CUST_DEMO_003 and CUST_DEMO_008.

cqs.question: How many customers activated with the selective discount (SELECTIVE_25PCT), and who are they?
cqs.expected_answer: One: CUST_DEMO_004.
